newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil halts trading in Banespa shrs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil halts trading in Banespa shrs.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it suspended trading in Sao Paulo state bank Banespa Wednesday following a request by Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM).

The suspension follows a report by Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper that the federal government would announce Thursday the final terms of a debt restructuring deal agreed with the Sao Paulo state government early this year.
Gazeta Mercantil said the federal government would sign Thursday contracts with Sao Paulo state for the refinancing of a 49.9 billion reais debt.
The restructuring deal also includes the transfer of Banespa to federal hands in a prior step to its privatization.
Last week, Gazeta reported that U.S. funds together with Brazilian investors were interested in Banespa.
Banespa shares had been climbing amid expectations over the final terms of the debt rescheduling. The bank's preferred shares rose 174.3 percent from April 9 to date, Gazeta said.
